title: Derived base change for a bounded relatively flat complex
statement: Let f:X\to S be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and let G^\bullet be a bounded-above complex of quasi-coherent \mathcal O_X-modules flat over S. For every morphism g:T\to S, with base change g':X_T\to X and f_T:X_T\to T, the canonical map Lg^*Rf_*(E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_X}G^\bullet) [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] \to Rf_{T,*}(L(g')^*E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{X_T}}(g')^*G^\bullet) is an isomorphism in D(\mathcal O_T).

proof.text: Use the chosen cartesian square sq and its canonical stalk algebra structures. The four algebra-map equations follow by reflexivity and the restriction equations of exists_tensorMap. Apply derivedPullback_torIndependent_flat_complex to the actual cohomologyModel for G at every point. Then counit_stalkCondition_of_localizedComparison transports those isomorphisms to the coordinate-based StalkCondition required by singleComplexBaseChangeCriterion.

Convert hbounded to G.IsStrictlyLE using Mathlib CochainComplex.isStrictlyLE_iff. Obtain a canonical tensor comparison from exists_canonicalPullbackTensorComparison and apply singleComplexBaseChangeCriterion to E,hE,G, the boundedness, quasi-coherence, and the stalk condition.

Apply tensorCounit_oneKFlat_coordinates to P,G and the canonical comparison. Transport its source and target isomorphisms along e using tensorIso and functor mapIso. Naturality of the canonical tensor comparison cancels e.inv followed by e.hom and gives the local counit compatibility at E.

Prove naturality of the recorded schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap from its defining adjunction transpose: the naturality of the two derived-pullback composition isomorphisms, the equality-induced functor isomorphism, and the adjunction counit combine into the naturality square. Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left and homEquiv_naturality_right transpose it. Rewrite the criterion using the compatibility of step 3, cancel the mapped target isomorphism, use base-change naturality at the source identification, and cancel its mapped isomorphism. The resulting base-change-map/counit composite is invertible. Precomposing with the map of the arbitrary isomorphism α gives the exact stated conclusion.

lean.statement: theorem relativelyFlat_derivedBaseChange_complex {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (g : T ⟶ S) [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [@MonoidalPreadditive _ _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf)] (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X E) (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (hbounded : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (G.X i)) (hqc : ∀ i : ℤ, (G.X i).IsQuasicoherent) (hflat : ∀ i : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.IsFlatOver (G.X i) f) (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ E) (α : E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P G (@curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf)))) : IsIso ((derivedPullback g).map ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map α.hom) ≫ schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P G (@curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf)))) ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit (pullback.fst f g)).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P G (@curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf))))))
